summary: Meta AI's ProgramBench GitHub repository released version 1.2.1, changing how the benchmark's mean score is computed to cover the full benchmark rather than only attempted items.

practices.reason: The scoring methodology change to compute mean_score over the full benchmark rather than only attempted items would affect how teams interpret or replicate ProgramBench results.
